description: Change part of a note under Notes/ or Captures/ without rewriting it. Give exactly one of: old_text + new_text (old_text must occur exactly once; new_text may be empty), section + content (replaces everything under that heading up to the next heading of the same or higher level; the heading itself stays), or append. Generated notes and the memory file cannot be edited. The reply lists existing notes the new text names without linking.

append.description: Markdown to add at the end of the note

old_text.description: Exact text to replace; must occur exactly once

section.description: Heading text of the section to replace, without the # marks

name: brain_edit
title: Edit part of a hand-written note
